landManager: Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest (Darrington Ranger District)
storedPass: Northwest Forest Pass required at Mountain Loop Highway trailheads — $5/day or $30/year.
drive: From SR-530 at Whitehorse, about 5 miles west of Darrington, turn left (south) onto Old Mine Road (387th Ave NE) at the gas station and drive 0.6 miles to the dead end.

landManager: Colville National Forest, Tonasket Ranger District (Pasayten Wilderness)
storedPass: Northwest Forest Pass / America the Beautiful Pass
drive: From Loomis, take County Road #9425 north 2 miles to County Road #4066/FR-39; follow FR-39 about 14 miles, then turn onto FR-3900-500 and follow it about 6 miles (high-clearance vehicle recommended, not advised for passenger cars) to the Iron Gate Trailhead.

storedPass: Northwest Forest Pass required at the Long Swamp trailhead — $5/day or $30/annual.
drive: From Loomis, drive north on County Road 9425 for about 2 miles, then turn west onto County Road 4066, which becomes FR-39, and follow it about 20 miles to Long Swamp Campground, where the trailhead is.

landManager: Colville National Forest, Tonasket Ranger District (Pasayten Wilderness)
storedPass: Northwest Forest Pass / America the Beautiful Pass
drive: From Loomis, drive north on County Road 9425 for 2 miles, turn west onto County Road 4066, which becomes Forest Road 39, and follow it about 20 miles to Long Swamp Campground. Continue about 3 miles on Forest Road 3900-300 to the Cathedral Driveway trailhead.

storedPass: Northwest Forest Pass required at trailheads (e.g. Andrews Creek, Chewuch River) — $5/day or $30/annual.
drive: Park at the Thirtymile Trailhead (~3,400 ft) at the end of West Chewuch Road, about 29 miles north of Winthrop.

names: Bruce's parking lot, Sinks Canyon Rd
